plan.title: Verify environment and package versions
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Install/pin ultralytics==8.1.0 if needed. Confirm GPU availability and VRAM.
plan.success_criteria: All critical packages at correct versions, GPU confirmed with VRAM reported

plan.title: Deep dive into dataset structure, annotations, and metadata
plan.hypothesis: Understanding the full dataset structure will inform model design choices
plan.description: Load data/train/annotations.json: count images, annotations, categories. Compute stats: annotations per image (min/max/mean), category frequency distribution, image dimensions. Examine bbox format, area, corrected flag, iscrowd. Identify the store sections from image filenames or metadata. Check category_id distribution — which categories are rare vs common. Check category 356 (unknown_product). Load metadata.json and understand its schema. Examine data/products/ structure (how many products have reference images, how many images per product, image sizes).
plan.success_criteria: Complete understanding of dataset: number of images, annotations, categories, image sizes, annotation density, category distribution, reference image availability

plan.title: Create train/val split, evaluation function, and YOLO data conversion
plan.hypothesis: A proper evaluation setup is essential before any training
plan.description: Install pycocotools. Create stratified 90/10 train/val split (seed=42) by store section. Write COCO-format split JSONs. Implement eval function: detection_mAP@0.5 (all preds mapped to single class) and classification_mAP@0.5 (original category_ids), combined as val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Convert COCO annotations to YOLO txt format for ultralytics. Create dataset YAML. Verify everything works with a dummy test.
plan.success_criteria: Working train/val split, evaluation function that returns val_score, and YOLO-format dataset ready for training

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8m nc=357 at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m at 1280px establishes a solid baseline, skipping smaller models since we have A800 GPUs
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m on train split with nc=357, imgsz=1280, 100 epochs, batch=16. Run inference on val split, evaluate with eval function. This skips n/s variants since we have ample GPU.

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=357 at 1280px, 200 epochs
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x improves over YOLOv8m by at least 0.03 val_score
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=357, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs, batch=8, close_mosaic=50. Compare val_score to baseline.

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 detection-only at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: Single-class detector achieves higher detection mAP since it only needs to localize
plan.description: Convert all annotations to category 0. Train YOLOv8x nc=1, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5. This will be the detection backbone for two-stage approach.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 higher than nc=357 model's detection mAP

plan.title: Explore DINOv2 embeddings for product classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings can distinguish between product categories using reference images
plan.description: Load DINOv2-base. Extract embeddings for: (a) cropped training annotations (sample ~500), (b) reference product images from data/products/. Measure same-category vs different-category similarity. Test kNN classification accuracy on val GT boxes with different k values and gallery compositions (reference only, crops only, mixed).
plan.success_criteria: kNN classification accuracy > 30% on val GT boxes, clear separation between same/different category similarities

plan.title: Two-stage: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 kNN classifier
plan.hypothesis: Two-stage approach achieves higher val_score than end-to-end nc=357 YOLO
plan.description: Use nc=1 YOLO detections on val split. For each detection, crop from original image, extract DINOv2-base embedding, kNN lookup against gallery. Evaluate full val_score. Also try DINOv2-large if base results are promising.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds best nc=357 YOLO result

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference for dense shelf detection
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference improves detection of small products by 3-5 mAP points
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice images into overlapping tiles (e.g., 1280x1280 with stride 960), run YOLO on each tile + full image, merge with NMS/WBF. Install ensemble-boxes if needed. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improves by at least 2 points over non-tiled inference

plan.title: NMS/confidence threshold tuning and TTA
plan.hypothesis: Tuning post-processing improves val_score by 1-3 points
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU threshold {0.4-0.8}, confidence threshold {0.05-0.3}, and test TTA (augment=True). Find optimal combination on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by at least 1 point over default thresholds

plan.title: Fine-tune DINOv2 projection head with ArcFace/SupCon loss
plan.hypothesis: Learned projection head improves classification mAP by 2-5 points over raw embeddings
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2, add 2-layer MLP projection head. Train with ArcFace loss on training crops + reference images. Evaluate classification improvement on val split with GT boxes, then with detected boxes.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improves by at least 2 points over raw DINOv2 kNN

plan.title: RT-DETR-l training and ensemble with YOLO
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling YOLO + RT-DETR with WBF improves detection by 2-4 mAP points
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l nc=1 at 1280px, 200 epochs. Combine with YOLO using WBF. Tune ensemble weights. Evaluate detection_mAP and full val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble detection_mAP exceeds best single model by at least 1.5 points

plan.title: Extended YOLO training: longer epochs, higher resolution, augmentation tuning
plan.hypothesis: Training YOLOv8x for 400 epochs at 1280-1600px with tuned augmentation improves detection
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with best settings found so far but 400 epochs, close_mosaic=100, label_smoothing=0.1. Also try 1600px if memory allows. Compare to previous best.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over previous best YOLO model

plan.title: Confidence gating: YOLO classes vs DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves classification
plan.description: For each detection, if YOLO nc=357 confidence > threshold use YOLO class, else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep threshold on val split. This combines strengths of both approaches.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over pure DINOv2 classification

plan.title: Optimal model combination for 420MB budget
plan.hypothesis: The right combination of detector + classifier within size constraints maximizes val_score
plan.description: Enumerate feasible combinations: (a) YOLOv8x FP16 + DINOv2-base FP16, (b) YOLOv8l FP16 + DINOv2-large FP16, (c) YOLOv8x INT8 + DINOv2-large FP16, (d) ensemble + DINOv2-base. Test top combinations on val split. Check total sizes.
plan.success_criteria: Identify best combination that fits in 420MB with highest val_score

plan.title: Build complete inference pipeline (run.py)
plan.description: Assemble best components into run.py: tiled inference (if beneficial), best detector, best classifier, optimal thresholds. Test end-to-end on val split. Profile inference time to ensure < 300s.
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces correct predictions.json, val_score matches expectations, inference < 300s

plan.title: Final ablation and sanity check
plan.hypothesis: Each component contributes positively to final val_score
plan.description: Run ablation: remove each component one at a time and measure val_score drop. Confirm every component is net positive. Run full pipeline on val split as final verification.
plan.success_criteria: All components contribute positively, final val_score is reproducible

plan.title: Package final submission
plan.description: Create submission.zip with run.py, model weights, gallery files, helper scripts. Verify: total size < 420MB, no blocked imports, correct output format. Test run.py with --input and --output args.
plan.success_criteria: submission.zip < 420MB, run.py works correctly with expected args
